interface.signature: def Reduced_String(k: int, s: str) -> str:

preconditions.description: k is a positive integer within the bounds of the string length.
s is a non-empty string with length up to 10^5.

postconditions.expression: all(len(group) < k or group[0] != group[1] for group in [list(g) for _, g in itertools.groupby(return_value)] if len(group) >= k)
postconditions.description: The output string has no group of k or more consecutive identical characters remaining.

postconditions.expression: all(len(return_value) <= len(s) and return_value == ''.join([c for c in s if not (len(list(g)) >= k and all(x == c for x in g)) for _, g in itertools.groupby(s)]) or return_value == ''.join([c for c in s if not (len(list(g)) >= k and all(x == c for x in g)) for _, g in itertools.groupby(s)]) if any(len(list(g)) >= k and all(x == c for x in g) for _, g in itertools.groupby(s)))
postconditions.description: The output string is obtained by iteratively removing all possible groups of k consecutive identical characters until no more such groups exist.
